content_html:
Universal Documentation Crawler, High-Density Markdown Extractor & BYOLLM Synthesis Toolkit

Built for LLM Context Windows (70%+ Token Noise Reduction):
Standard web scrapers dump megabytes of raw HTML, repetitive navigation menus, cookie banners, and script tags that exhaust context windows and dilute model attention. docxtract is specifically engineered to produce compact, high-density, concise Markdown extracts. It preserves code blocks, YAML schemas, markdown tables, and video walkthrough links while eliminating 70%+ of webpage noise—giving your local or cloud LLM pure, high-signal context with zero token bloat.

Why docxtract?

Feature Standard Web Scrapers (Firecrawl, Puppeteer) docxtract
Context Density High token bloat (navbars, footers, cookie banners) 70%+ noise stripped; pure content signal
Video Streams Stripped or lost Preserves <mux-player> M3U8, Loom, and YouTube embeds
Synthesis Engine Raw markdown dumps only Built-in multi-stage Map-Reduce into master_review.md
Local LLM Support Cloud API focused Native BYOLLM (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio)
Thinking Models Prompt bloat triggers context limits Token exhaustion safeguards for DeepSeek-R1
IDE Integration Custom scripts required Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude & Cursor
User Interface CLI only Interactive Web UI (localhost:7860) & 1-Click Colab

Architecture

                       ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
                       │ Target Documentation / Course Portal    │
                       └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                                            │
                                            ▼
                       ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
                       │         docxtract Crawl Engine          │
                       │  - Cleans boilerplate, nav & footers    │
                       │  - Extracts Mux streams, iframes, video │
                       │  - Generates structured Markdown files  │
                       └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                                            │
                                            ▼
                       ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
                       │     Universal BYOLLM Client Layer       │
                       │  - llama.cpp (http://localhost:8080/v1) │
                       │  - Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1)   │
                       │  - LM Studio / vLLM / OpenAI / Groq     │
                       └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                                            │
                                            ▼
                       ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
                       │   Master Review & Synthesis Engine      │
                       │  - Stage 1: Document Distillation       │
                       │  - Stage 2: Executive Synthesis         │
                       │  - Stage 3: Master Compendium Assembly  │
                       └─────────────────────────────────────────┘

Real-World Showcase

Check out the real-world extraction and synthesis generated from 12 articles of the Warp Software Factory engineering course: 👉 View the 1,220-line Master Technical Review

  • Raw HTML Size: ~115,000 tokens
  • docxtract Markdown Size: ~18,000 tokens (84% token reduction)
  • Synthesis Time: ~2 minutes with local Ollama (llama3.3)

Quickstart

1. Installation

Install via PyPI:

pip install docxtract-ai

Or install from source:

git clone https://github.com/raycollabs/docxtract.git
cd docxtract
pip install -e .

2. Launch the Web UI

docxtract ui

Open http://localhost:7860 in your browser. Configure your target URL, pick your model preset, test the endpoint, and run the pipeline!

CLI Usage

Test Endpoint Connection

# Check local llama.cpp
docxtract test-llm --base-url http://localhost:8080/v1

# Check local Ollama
docxtract test-llm --base-url http://localhost:11434/v1 --model llama3.3

Crawl Documentation

docxtract crawl https://www.warp.dev/learn --depth 2 --output ./output

Synthesize Master Review

docxtract synthesize ./output --base-url http://localhost:11434/v1 --model llama3.3

Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

docxtract includes a native stdio MCP server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf. Your AI assistant can crawl and synthesize documentation directly inside your IDE!

Add to Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json)

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "docxtract": {
      "command": "docxtract",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}

Add to Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json)

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "docxtract": {
      "command": "docxtract",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}

Exposed MCP Tools:

  • crawl_docs: Crawls an entire doc portal into clean markdown.
  • extract_page: Instantly extracts a single documentation URL into dense markdown for prompt injection.
  • synthesize_docs: Synthesizes a folder of docs into master_review.md using local BYOLLM.
